name: Full map zoom progression and bounded debug teleport acceptance

steps._note: NOT RUN. User owns game testing. Open Map at original5120x1440 and current UI scale. Test wheel/Shift/gamepad in both directions at detail/intermediate/world-overview levels, including rapid reversal while easing. No automatic teleport or game-control step.

With native debug teleport permission, Ctrl-right-click an independently known valid world point at center/corners. Verify requested/landed coordinates and native player marker match the click and terrain. Repeat at negative coordinates, another UI scale and odd/extreme aspect. Waypoint placement must still follow native behavior.

Click beyond playable world or native90m safety edge. Expect localized rejection and no move/respawn, rather than a silent boundary landing. The wider map can legitimately display outside-world fog. Do not bypass the native boundary, debug permission or spawn safety checks.
